header: The Sensex, Nifty and watch-list answer, with a copy kept for the bad minutes. Yahoo Finance turns away anyone who asks too fast, so I ask for each symbol one at a time, keep it five minutes in memory, and at the first "too many requests" I ask for no more. A symbol that could not be had now falls back to its LAST GOOD QUOTE: first the one in memory, then the one saved in the database (src/lib/live/marketStore.ts, which survives a restart). Those quotes are shown as they were, with `saved` saying which ones and when they were received, so the card can say "not live" and never shows an old figure as new. Only when there is nothing at all is it an error. Every fresh quote is saved. This is pure but for what it is handed (the fetcher, the memory, the store), so it is tested without the network.

behaviours: when Yahoo answers, the figures are fresh, nothing is marked saved, and every quote is saved for later
when Yahoo turns us away the saved copy is shown, all of it marked saved with the time it was received; Yahoo is asked once, not for every symbol
a mix of fresh and saved: only the saved ones are named, the fresh one is kept and saved
memory: a quote younger than five minutes is used as fresh without asking; an older one is a copy (marked); a saved row fills another; the rest are missing
the newer of the copy in memory (10 minutes old) and the saved row (two days old) is shown
nothing fresh, in memory or saved is the plain error
a store that throws does not break the answer: the copy in memory is still shown
